title: Inbound Message Acceptance Response (v1)
description: Synchronous acceptance response for POST /v1/adapters/{adapterId}/messages. First acceptance returns HTTP 202 with status 'accepted'; identical replay (same (adapterId, messageId) key, same canonical payload) returns HTTP 200 with status 'duplicate' and the original correlation id; same key plus different canonical payload is a conflict (HTTP 409). The correlation id is core-generated, opaque, and stable for all replays of the same (adapterId, messageId) pair.

status.description: Acceptance status. 'accepted' on first receipt (HTTP 202); 'duplicate' on identical replay (HTTP 200) with the original correlation id.

correlationId.description: Core-generated opaque correlation id, stable for all replays of the same (adapterId, messageId) pair.
